title: Globular Cluster Omega Centauri
explanation:
# Omega Centauri: A Cosmic Puzzle

Deep in the halo surrounding our Milky Way lies Omega Centauri, a colossal ball of 10 million ancient stars packed into a region 150 light-years across—so densely packed and impossibly old that astronomers believe it may be the shattered core of a small galaxy that collided with ours billions of years ago. Hubble Space Telescope observations spanning two decades have revealed that a massive black hole lurks at its heart, adding another mystery to this unusual cluster whose stars display a strange range of ages and chemical compositions unlike typical star clusters.
